title: TokWatt: AI Inference Energy Database
subtitle: Boundary-annotated energy estimates for chat, agents, images and video
description: TokWatt collects first-hand estimates of the energy used by AI inference, records each with its measurement boundary and functional unit, and derives harmonized per-task reference values. See README.md, DATA_DICTIONARY.md and DATASHEET.md. Version 0.1.0.

resources.description: One row per published estimate with boundary flags and harmonized energy (Wh)
